about: Ransom's Rest's town dressing (the 'make it alive' polish, concept board A_town): the pieces Tools/Unreal/build_area_dressing.py places instanced when layout.json's level.town names this file, the chicken yards' picket lines, the no-tree areas the scatter keeps out of, and what waits for the user's approval. Made by make_town.py beside this file from layout.json, Saved/MeshBounds.json and (when Main has run Saved/rr_town_probe.py) Saved/RRTownProbe.json; edit those and run it again, never this file. Unreal cm, X north, Y east, yaw in degrees from +X. pieces: mesh without SM_; at its pivot; lift cm over the ground under it (or over the piece hangFrom names: what stands on a walk, in a wagon's bed, on a crate); tilt [pitch, roll] added; solid overrides the mesh's default (wall and hanging pieces have none); kind prop, upright or flat. lines: picket fences (build_area_dressing.KITS), points in order, closed, gates [X, Y, width]. noTrees: polygons. deferred: the new clutter (Art/Models/Props/FrontierClutter.py, look sheet 42) waiting for approval, by mesh, with counts; deferredPieces: those pieces in full, at the spots they keep (make_town.py APPROVED moves a mesh's into pieces, unmoved). lights: the pieces that carry SOCKET_Light, lit at dusk (offset: the socket in the piece's frame, cm; candelas by day and at dusk; gloom: candelas in the smog; reach cm; deferred with their piece). spots: the small animals' places (chickens in their yards, the porch cat), pending approval.
